title: What's new in v6?
reported_observation: Official documentation describes v6, v6-wild and v6-mini as variants with different creative goals, and says all three support generations up to eight minutes.
creator_interpretation: Model variant is a necessary metadata field for experiments; v6-wild should not be pooled with v6 results.
our_hypothesis: The three variants may produce different prompt-response distributions and should be compared as separate experimental conditions.
